_about: Curated catalog: the MEANING layer for the score keys the corpus actually contains.
Existence is not guessed. scripts/extract_score_keys.py derives 138 (module, column_key,
variant) identities from the 200 distinct keys in candidates.scores. This file curates 22 of
those — the ones a UI will actually show — as 28 rows, because iptm, protein_iptm and
complex_ipde are each split into three INTERFACE variants. scripts/seed_metric_skeleton.py
registers the remaining 116 as uncurated, with the value type inferred from the data but no
display name, unit or direction invented for them.
provenance: 'inferred' = read off a module README (docs/../model-reference/MODULE_OUTPUTS.md).
'aws_confirmed' = stated by AWS. Only pseudo_perplexity and the SFvCSP transform qualify.
Re-runnable: scripts/seed_catalog.py upserts on natural keys, so edit and re-run freely.

concepts.name: interface_confidence
concepts.label: Interface confidence
concepts.description: Is the predicted contact between two chains real? Scale and meaning vary by producing module, and for Boltz2 also by which chains were folded - see the INTERFACE variants.

concepts.name: fold_confidence
concepts.label: Fold confidence
concepts.description: Is the predicted 3D shape right? Independent of whether anything binds. 0-1 in Boltz2 but 0-100 in ColabFold/ESMFold, so never compare across modules.

concepts.name: epitope
concepts.label: Epitope
concepts.description: Which residues of the target the binder contacts.

concepts.name: humanness
concepts.label: Humanness
concepts.description: How closely a sequence resembles human antibody repertoires; a proxy for immunogenicity risk, not a measurement of it.

concepts.name: sequence_liability
concepts.label: Sequence liability
concepts.description: Motifs that degrade, modify or misbehave during manufacture and storage.

concepts.name: sequence_naturalness
concepts.label: Sequence naturalness
concepts.description: How probable a sequence is under a protein language model. Different models disagree, so the model is part of the metric's identity.

concepts.name: paratope_physchem
concepts.label: Paratope physicochemistry
concepts.description: Charge and hydrophobicity properties of the binding loops.

modules.name: boltz2
modules.description: Co-folding model: predicts the 3D structure of a complex and its confidence.

modules.name: structure_analysis_boltz2
modules.description: Geometric analysis of a Boltz2 structure: epitope residues, interface distances, chain lengths.

modules.name: biophi
modules.description: Humanizes an antibody and scores humanness against the Observed Antibody Space (OAS) repertoires.

modules.name: humatchclassify
modules.description: CNN humanness classifier; an independent second opinion alongside BioPhi's OASis.

modules.name: liabilities
modules.description: Counts sequence motifs known to cause manufacturing or storage problems.

modules.name: temstapro
modules.description: Predicts thermostability from sequence using protein language model embeddings.

modules.name: evoprotgrad
modules.description: Gradient-guided directed evolution over a protein language model.

modules.name: fastdpe
modules.description: Fast developability profile estimation: paratope charge, hydrophobicity, CDR geometry.

metrics.notes: 0.196-0.793 observed in this corpus. Assembly-wide, so a 2-chain H/T fold and a 3-chain H/L/T fold are not strictly comparable even within this variant.
~0.95 observed. NOT binding: no antigen was in the fold. Runs higher than any genuine complex, so it tops a naive ipTM leaderboard.
Always 0.000 - one chain has no interface. Direction NEUTRAL on purpose: a constant is not a quality signal and must not be sorted on.
Tracks protein_iptm exactly in this corpus; kept separate because Boltz2 emits both.

9.52 A observed for real complexes. Lower is better, so this is the ipTM trap inverted: the target-free folds score BETTER here. Unit spelled out rather than the Angstrom sign: this string reaches Windows consoles.
0.47 A observed - twenty times tighter than a real complex, because the only interface here is the antibody's own heavy-light pairing. Not a binding measurement.
Always 0.000 - one chain has no interface to measure error across. NEUTRAL like its ipTM counterpart: a constant must not be sortable, and here a naive lower-is-better sort would rank it best of all.
0-1 in Boltz2 but 0-100 in ColabFold/ESMFold/RoseTTAFold2. No INTERFACE variant: it stays meaningful (0.906) for a lone chain.
Neutral: a bigger contact patch is not automatically better.

Semicolon-delimited residue numbers in the Boltz2 PDB's own numbering, which is why the 3D viewer can paint them without remapping. Typed CATEGORICAL because MetricValueType has no LIST/TEXT member - the least-wrong fit, worth revisiting.
The Before/After pair is the only place the humanization step's effect is visible as a number.
Percentile against OAS repertoires. Our humanized line sits at 0.24 - honestly not very human yet.
Independently trained from OASis, so the two can disagree - which is the point of running both.
The most serious of the set: a glycan attached inside a binding loop can abolish binding outright, unlike a framework site.
mesophilic | thermophilic. Categorical, so no direction.
One representative cutoff. TemStaPro emits t40-t80 in raw and binary form - 22 columns sampling one concept at nine temperatures.

EvoProtGrad names the column after the language model (esm_pseudolikelihood_ratio), so the model is recoverable from the data alone. Modelled as one metric with two PARAMETER variants rather than two metrics.
One of only two AWS-confirmed entries in this catalog. Lower = the model finds the sequence more natural.
The Mahalanobis transform is AWS-confirmed. A raw and a '-transformed' form exist; when the transformed variant is seeded it uses VariantKind.TRANSFORM.
